rows.text: # First composed source budget

2026-09-13. LOCAL DISPOSITION — no owner ruling required. Planned compiler budget;
the source fixture's current manually coordinated schedule is not a public compiler.

Keep MaximumQualifiedSources=32. Count completed selectors, not sensing opportunities,
present samples, successful acquisitions or surviving children. Define the compiled
operation list before execution; unavailable/empty outcomes do not remove a requested
selector. A source that was never requested does not fabricate an empty selection.
For the first four-trial profile:

| Original group | Count | Requested formation selector | Domain slots |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
| Before and After body observations | 8 | Body | 8 |
| Separate start/end visual observations | 8 | Event | 8 |
| Later actual body cue, durable capacity0 | 1 | Body, independent of cue admission | 1 |
| Later event competitor formation | 1 | Event | 1 |
| Goal adoption/withdrawal, delivery, attribution, retention | bounded separately | None | 0 |

Total18 domain slots leaves14 for additional explicitly compiled controls. The panel
is context evidence; its presence alone does not require an event formation selector
in a body-only original. This is a bounded source operation schedule, not a general
attention inhibition law. Positive visual content remains perceivable when the panel
is missing. Combined originals requesting both formation selectors consume two slots,
even if one or both selections are empty. They remain a required branch witness.

At most one acquisition per source bounds all successful formations across the run by
32, including immediately lost ones. Thus the maximum prior+fresh memory batch is32
without requiring hidden truncation; forgetting cannot free a protocol source slot.
The cue-only cognitive operation adds no source, while its independently requested
zero-capacity body selector does. Do not confuse these two contributions.

The existing source-composition fixture has17 formations and does not yet execute
that extra empty selector at the cue instant. Its current receipt remains component
evidence, not proof of the planned18-source compiler. Whole public input count, queue,
work/output bounds and complete-prefix validation remain OPEN. The bound must be
computed from the actual admitted operation list before public activation.
# Matched footprint cohort
LOCAL DISPOSITION, 2026-09-19. GA OPEN; no owner decision. Counters **706 / 0**.

Add eight exact models: Independent, HistoricalShared, HistoricalHybrid and
RetiredFlat, each with sparse/dense source frames. Both use spatial allocation,
priority selection K2, four encodings at3..6 and later cues at7..10. Sparse has only
the focal Actor; dense adds two peripheral Participants. The focal actor's geometry,
role, timing, permission and later cue are unchanged. Dense has three eligible units
and capacity two. Body/panel/concern source and every non-footprint parameter match.
The nonfocal participants are not relabelled as Incidental; this profile makes no
claim to derive that currently unavailable role classification.

The commitment differs because source frames are model data. Comparison aligns
actual actor/participant evidence by its explicit role and source position, never
by the magnitude of an opaque occurrence ID. All raw identities remain in trace.
No hand-authored strength, memory, graph, recollection or prior prediction is seeded.

Stage C competitors are the four already accepted laws. Record exact focal strength,
association and later score differences; do not select a preferred law in advance.
RetiredFlat remains a negative control. The existing independent/shared/hybrid
arithmetic verdict remains in force and is not replaced by this finite witness.

North Star transfer: distinguish permitted perception, limited selection, encoding,
retained evidence, association and later retrieval under a controlled footprint.
The next gate is exact successor image review preserving all35 frozen images,
followed by actual public matched runs and a corpus/0.28.0 coverage verdict.
# General Attention integrated producers — 2026-09-19

**Disposition:** LOCAL DISPOSITION; GA OPEN; work continues.
**Stage (Brief §9):** A/B internal producer and owner integration, not public qualification.

## Counters
| Counter | Value |
|---|---|
| Highest allocated record type | **706** |
| Allocated since last verdict/corpus member | **0** |
## What changed

The primary owner has connected actual physical sampling, SEM tracking/binding/freezing,
selection, encoding, acquisition formation, memory retention, association settlement,
recall publication and presentation settlement to the concrete declaration compiler.
Output admission uses the scheduler allocator callback, actual producer receipts,
conditional experience reservations and exact stage output specifications. State patches
use registered ownership and compare-and-set expectations; canonical state restoration
now admits GA leaf values beneath the existing state envelope.

Terminal workspace/appraisal/concern adapters and strictly later feedback delivery are
connected internally. The calibrated feedback encoder now accepts the model budget and
threshold while retaining its historical defaults for existing controls. The actual
inherited regulatory probe interpreter is bound to the GA subject/source recipe;
measurement intake, M1 evidence and prediction now execute through actual one-use
producer associations. Goal command/deadline, consequence assessment, later focal and
qualification deliveries, unavailable attribution, significance joins and capped physical
replenishment are integrated internally. Positive retained attribution/credit remains owed.

The source-cohort scheduler now executes the eight committed opportunities under the
actual deterministic scheduler. Terminal owner groups preflight collisions and calculate
from common B0. Runtime-only protocol enrollment handles zero acquisitions without a
cognitive memory read; cue-only presentation updates read roster/history only. This
internal runtime uses diagnostic lists, not qualified public trace records or ModelIdentity.
Its source-only ceiling remains distinct from the whole-model budget.
## Evidence

Focused checks passed: inherited reads **11**, output slots **11**, integrated source/state
**8**, concern production **5**. The source/state integration executes all eight committed
opportunities: four formation instants followed by four actual safe cue instants, with
canonical state round trips, genuine recollection publication, and presentation updates.
Unavailable recall reads only the roster and allocates no recollections. The weak third
association rounds to zero and is pruned while positive episodic evidence remains retained.
Existing visual formation **10** and prior-concern **6** controls passed. The full
suite passed **1,983 tests / 257 files** (476.68 seconds). That run preceded
the latest inherited-source, terminal, feedback and scheduler additions. The subsequent
build passed; a final build after those additions is still owed. Latest focused checks:
declaration/terminal **57**, inherited-source/prediction/concern **15**, source/state
**9**, feedback **1**, expanded terminal **6**, source scheduler **5**. Scheduler cases
cover baseline, select-k0, recall-k0, denied-port and injected terminal rollback, including
state, outputs, protocol, pending children and allocator positions. TypeScript passes.

These tests do not establish public source authentication, whole-model admission, complete
prefix replay, positive retained use/significance through the scheduler, or Stage C verdicts.
No ModelIdentity, contract, allocation, corpus digest, or frozen historical receipt changed.
## Stage C competitor

Retain the concrete baseline versus priority/equal-priority, budget, spatial, association,
access, source-availability and independent encoding/retrieval feedback recipes. Retention
continues to use the actual SignificanceFirst component with its age/use/shared controls.
Concern A/B/C remain candidates. Integration sensitivity does not settle a psychological law.
## North Star transfer

Supports the §30 retrieval archetypes by joining observer-safe experience to retained
episodic evidence, associative access and presentation history without making graph
membership equivalent to memory availability. The transient concern seam preserves
known-zero, unavailable and disabled branches and does not redefine general Affect.
## Next gate

Compose inherited measurement/prediction and later feedback with the scheduler, complete
positive goal/attribution/use/significance joins, then admit the whole model with complete
work/slot accounting and public replay.
The 80-invocation/58-output bound is still GA-local only.
## Owner decision pending
# Ninth visual cue: bounded source successor
2026-09-13. LOCAL DISPOSITION — no owner ruling required.

Four trials require eight independently sampled positions. Retrieving those event
acquisitions through an actual later visual cue requires a ninth visual sweep.
The old eight-sweep marker tracker and eight-frame display cannot express that
sequence. A host-supplied recalled event set is not an acceptable substitute.

Select an explicit nine-sweep successor, with at most3 detections per sweep, and
a nine-frame single-marker display for the first witness. Preserve the old8-sweep/
8-detection component constructor and its ninth-sweep rejection controls unchanged.
The marker matching law, SEM file allocator, replay guards and false-tracking behavior
are unchanged. The new finite horizon is profile construction, not new psychology.

Starting with the admitted empty tracking state, at most27 distinct continuant files
can be introduced across this successor. All retained event keys and learned graph
keys must originate in that same horizon. Their union is therefore at most27, even
when graph nodes outlive episodic children, fitting the existing32-key access bound.
This argument requires the public no-external-key/source closure; graph membership
cannot be used to truncate direct episodic keys. An arbitrary preloaded graph would
invalidate the bound and is not admitted by this first profile.

The ninth visual observation is cue-only in the first paired body/visual recall
opportunity. It does not imply a completed visual acquisition selector. The existing
body zero-capacity selector still completes and consumes its source slot. Thus the
previous18-source calculation is preserved:16 original formations, one empty body
selection, one later competitor formation. If a future profile also requests visual
acquisition selection at the cue, it must account for that extra source explicitly.

Preserve eight-sweep-only research as the earlier bounded control. Reopen the work
bound when a required source has more sweeps/detections or permits prior external
files; do not change matching, cognitive capacity or canonical identity semantics.
Public source/selected-wrapper/cue/owner and persistence qualification remain OPEN.
# General Attention public phase reconciliation

2026-09-13. LOCAL DISPOSITION — no owner ruling required. Proposed registration
constraints, not runtime qualification or whole-contract acceptance.

Use the actual SEM-H phases: current observation/tracking/binding/classification/
freeze/roles are10/11/12/13/14/15; consequence equivalents are120/121/122/123/124/125.
World outcome/replenishment is110. The older stage draft and direct component call
order do not supersede these constants. Phase150 remains unschedulable.

| Operation | Proposed phase | Ordering/ownership constraint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Authored visual world scene |0| Existing WorldEventTruth/Binding occurrence production, source-side only |
| Current sensing through roles |10..15| Actual requested products, SEM owner updates and conditional freeze |
| Earlier-feedback delivery |15| Actual earlier completed producer and exact receiving original/instant |
| Current selection/cue/rank/encoding |40| Separate selectors and cues; selected-only encoding; no future outcome read |
| Current task workspace |40| Preserve the accepted Campaign-2 workspace phase; exact admitted operands |
| Current attribution/appraisal/concern |50| Appraisal and concern remain distinct same-phase transitions with causal parents; exact registrations still required |
| External replenishment |110| Original-only physical intervention; no learning route |
| Consequence sensing through roles |120..125| Reads effects already available before120; one actual freeze |
| Consequence selection/encoding and goal assessment |130| Goal assessment independently reads its permitted prior retained baseline |
| Acquisition evidence/result staging |130| Actual positive selected content only; one new acquisition per successful selection |
| Ordinary memory, graph, presentation, goal settlement |140| Declared separate owners, complete batch, no child emissions |
| Formation protocol hooks |Before whole-instant commit| Dedicated protocol authority; exact audit/owner results, no cognitive read |

These are phase constraints, not permission to collapse the listed operations into
one unregistered handler. Each transition still needs exact input/output, producer,
occurrence, route, PRJ, accessor, write and failure declarations. Current and consequence
branches may share pure operators but cannot share a falsely labeled registration.

Campaign-2 registrations in `src/campaign2/cognitiveExecution.ts` use workspace40,
appraisal50 and concern50. This working proposal now reflects those phases; it does
not amend the accepted contract or introduce phases51/52.
## Physical preparations

Apply the explicit source schedule in GA_PHYSICAL_SOURCE_SCHEDULE_REV1. Earlier
preparations at20/40/60 occur at110 before next-instant current samples21/41/61.
Outcome deliveries at4/24/44/64 occur at110 before same-instant consequence sensing120.
Do not introduce a phase0 physical writer or hidden adaptive preparation controller.
## Goal lifecycle

The proposed initial goal root is empty at clock0. Use an actual adoption original
at1, with AdoptedAt=ActiveFrom=1 and ExpiresAt=100, rather than silently seeding the
goal or scheduling an original at initial clock0. First motion is2; assessments are
later consequences. Before evidence does not require a goal already active when it
was encoded. The first bounded schedule has no assessment at a lifecycle instant.

A goal-command proposal before140 may schedule both its same-instant terminal owner
operation and its exact future deadline. Both pending queue effects roll back if
adoption fails. The140 owner cannot enqueue its own deadline. Withdrawal at70 leaves
the authenticated deadline pending; at100 it is a no-op for the already Withdrawn
goal, not a second lifecycle transition. An Open goal instead expires exactly at100.
The existing pure Expire command remains invalid for a terminal goal; a scheduled
deadline guard must distinguish the no-op case before invoking that command.

The future public compiler must prove exact deadline/goal/adoption association and
once-only completion. This does not authorize arbitrary repeated deadline calls or
generic queue cancellation. An assessment simultaneous with lifecycle settlement
remains outside this first closed schedule; admitting it requires an explicit
ordering extension that satisfies the goal seam's settled-state read rule.
## Preserved separation

Immediate durable encoding means this instant's normal commit, not an early40 write.
Its historical factors cannot consume this instant's later outcome. Earlier authentic
concern delivery remains a distinct permitted variant. Later significance at72 uses
the frozen64 qualification and actual71 attribution, after70 withdrawal; it cannot
recompute or rewrite the old qualification. All shared140 operations require explicit
batch composition and rollback, not sibling-state visibility or post-commit repair.
# Bounded retained-credit cohort

LOCAL DISPOSITION under CAMPAIGN3_DECISION_AND_ESCALATION_POLICY.md. GA OPEN;
implementation continues. Counters **706 / 0**; no new allocation or owner ruling.

The existing source cohort has four formation opportunities followed by four cues,
with event/body recall capacities two. It cannot supply the sixteen distinct retained
Before/Motion/Motion/After experiences required by the accepted four-trial attribution
component. That finite scope is not an architectural blocker. Preserve that cohort and
add a separate fixture beneath the existing source, retention and credit contracts.

The new fixture has four trials beginning at 3, 16, 20 and 33, a later cue at 37,
and fresh body/event acquisitions at 40/41: **19** observation opportunities,
**10** visual sweeps, **16** panel sweeps and **18** selection
slots, all within accepted bounds. Before/After samples request signal A only; Motion
samples select one actual visible actor. The source displays motion 0→1 in trials 0/2
and stationary 0→0 in trials 1/3. Reserve A starts at 23 and retains the existing
decay rate of one. Physical replenishments are +13 at 6, +4 at 19 and +13 at 23.
All four actual Before intervals are 20..21, as required by the accepted matched
contrast. After at 6/23 is sampled in the consequence lane after replenishment;
After at 19 is sampled in the current lane before replenishment. This authored
correlation is fixture data, not a new action-effect law.

Recall capacities eight per partition retain and publish the sixteen required
acquisitions. The goal is adopted at 1; its first After consequence is assessed at 6
against the actual retained Before view. Frozen focal delivery targets the cue at 37;
qualification and attribution deliveries target a separate significance opportunity
at 38. Retention runs at 39; fresh acquisitions at 40/41 apply capacity pressure.
Neither current goal state nor physical truth substitutes for those deliveries.

Stage C competitors: `credit-age-only`, `credit-use-only`,
`credit-shared-protection`, `credit-significance-first`. They share source, sampling,
selection, acquisition and recall data, differing only in the accepted retention
policy. Historical EffectProvenance remains prohibited as a cognitive input.
MEC-007/CTL-004 outcome relevance remains a consolidation candidate;
MEC-008/009/010 remain controls, with association, access and presentation distinct.
This does not instantiate the historical realized-Need law or qualify general Affect.

North Star transfer: test the actual observer-side path from retained experience to
fallible attribution and directional significance, without treating co-occurrence,
successful grouping or canonical identity as causal truth. Existing false-attribution
and hidden-delivery comparisons remain preservation obligations.

Status: all four declaration packets and full scheduled retention comparisons PASS.
Actual recall supplies sixteen experiences; attribution is Supported, marks all
sixteen consumed children used, and targets the first motion's endpoint child.
MovingCloser significance reaches that one child through the actual later join.
Under pressure AgeOnly retains two fresh acquisitions and fourteen used ones;
UseOnly, SharedProtection and SignificanceFirst retain sixteen used acquisitions
and reject both fresh ones. All retain the significant endpoint. This fixture does
not distinguish the latter three policies and earns no necessity verdict for
significance priority. The inherited task deadline at 21 also passes in the full
SignificanceFirst run. Public trace/identity/persistence qualification and corpus
verdicts remain owed. No psychological reduction follows from admission alone.
# General Attention workspace read checkpoint — 2026-09-19

**Disposition:** LOCAL DISPOSITION; task/prediction read adapter implemented. Whole compiler/public GA OPEN.
**Stage (Brief §9):** B — bounded internal workspace path; public source admission remains OPEN.
## Counters

| Counter | Value |
|---|---|
| Highest allocated record type | 706 |
| Allocated since last verdict/corpus member | 0 |
## What changed

The concrete declaration compiler now binds `generalWorkspace.ts` to the accepted
`task-cognitive-path/0.1-candidate` transformation. It resolves the authoritative
subject roster, reads the exact committed task/prediction keys through inherited
accessor identities, validates present leaves, and returns detached canonical
workspace bytes and actual-read records. The existing transformation controls which
reads occur; the adapter supplies no caller-selected task, prediction or calculation.

The input observer/agenda and supplied occurrence grammar are checked before state
access. Runtime source authentication, occurrence freshness/reservation, invocation
admission and rollback remain separate obligations; this internal method is not a
public execution capability.
## Local disposition

Preserve MEC-020's active-only task lifecycle and MEC-007's separately traceable
relevance path. Disabled task access reads only the roster. Capacity1 and disabled
prediction access retain the selected task without reading prediction. Missing or
inactive tasks prevent prediction access; the active window is [2,21). An absent
prediction remains unavailable, while a present zero forecast remains known zero.
No mechanism is retired, no new schema is allocated, and no owner ruling is needed.
## Evidence

`src/test/generalWorkspace.test.ts` adds 13 tests covering exact inherited members,
read order, excluded-read poison controls, lifecycle boundaries, absence versus zero,
foreign subjects/agendas, invalid slot namespace/time, invalid state leaves and
detached results. One initial test used an incomplete PerceivedSatisfied union; it
was corrected to the valid DeadlineMissed variant before the passing run.

Affected run: **120 tests / 7 files PASS** (`generalWorkspace`,
`generalDeclarationProfile`, `generalAccessors`, `generalSourceDeclarations`,
`campaign2CognitiveTransforms`, `priorConcernFeedback`, `generalRegistration`),
with two workers. Typecheck, production build and reference-boundary check PASS.
The prior full-suite result of 1,918/252 predates the source/protocol increment and
was not rerun here. Frozen contracts, model bytes, corpus and historical receipts
remain unchanged. This checkpoint is the evidence record; no manifest revision is
needed for a change confined to an internal adapter.
## Stage C competitor

The committed `source-capacity1`, `source-no-task-access` and
`source-no-prediction-access` recipes remain executable comparators to baseline.
Concern A/B/C and the encoding-law competitors remain retained. Read exclusion
tests establish implementation sensitivity, not psychological necessity or a verdict.
## North Star transfer

Supports the §30 angry-person retrieval archetype by preserving the distinction
between an accessible task, an available prediction and the downstream concern
response. Capacity/access controls cannot silently acquire excluded prediction
evidence. This does not establish general Affect or public retrieval coverage.
## Next gate

Complete inherited SEM tracking/physical sampling read integration and transactional
output-slot admission, then source/subject/owner authentication and whole-model
ownership. The 80/58 ceiling remains GA-local; whole-model identities and budgets
remain OPEN. The same primary owner retains steps 2–3.
## Owner decision pending
No. Corpus/0.28.0 has 21 members; the verdict ledger has 12 entries.
